[b]Hi![/b]

I've been listening to your feedback and working hard to improve your experience. This update addresses several issues and introduces some quality-of-life improvements. 

[b]Added:[/b]
- Time information and need display during sleep
- Letter with bicycle information and a short quest to visit the hobby shop

[b]Fixed:[/b]
- Player position now loads correctly (related to player home appearing as a white cube)

notes.title: Patch 0.4.0 - Soundtrack, Gardening, and Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38333011/0461d8e063733c1b52fc5d3977c88ed02bcc5480.png[/img]

[b]Hi![/b]

Get ready for a refreshing new update to your island life! Patch 0.4.0 brings a wave of exciting features and improvements to enhance your Sunny Life experience:

[b]Full Soundtrack[/b]: Immerse yourself in the island's atmosphere with our complete full soundtrack! Almost 20 new music samples is waiting for you to discover.

[b]Toolbar[/b]: Easy access to items in your inventory!

[b]Gardening Enhancements:[/b] A fertiliser has been added to increase the quality of the crop. Watering Cans have been added too, as well as a domestic tap where it can be filled with water.

[b]User Interface Upgrades:[/b] Tons of new features, like cookbook being accessible all the time!

[b]Gamepad Support[/b]: Now you can play comfortably from your couch or on your steamdeck!

[b]New begining[/b] A new cutscene adding depth to the beginning of the game. In addition, dialogues have been modified and player starts his life in new home with a sleeping bag

[b]Quality of Life changes:[/b] Many minor changes have been made. From walking- instead of running- NPCs, to a flag signalling mail to be collected.

I've also squashed some pesky bugs to ensure your island life runs as smoothly as possible. Thank you for your continued support. I'm waiting for your feedback on new changes on our discord and please enjoy the update!

Discord: https://discord.gg/rMzTd7WZj6

notes.title: DunHero x The Sunny Life + Upcoming update this week!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38333011/5f290746aabce949ef94f616af1f63c73fa3fd22.png[/img]

[b]Hi guys![/b]

I hope to bring new some wonderful and exciting news! Today, together with DunHero, we published a special colab bundle -  you can buy both games in a special promo price. If you haven’t heard about the DunHero just yet I will let you know it is an action rogue-like RPG made by single programmer (the same way as The Sunny LIfe). 
When you feel adventurous you can hop onto new challenges in DunHero or, whenever you want to just chill and ‘touch the grass’ you can switch to The Sunny Life and enjoy your experience of simple life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38333011/f2335dde910b3e9bd2921695967f189d9e8f24e5.png[/img]

I hope you are as excited as I am regarding new game updates and see you with more news on weekend!

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0.1f - First Person Perspective Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38333011/c71fece2adbef972e5d6e1c8dc9d98997a5bbb71.png[/img]

Hi!

As you may or may not have noticed, I have been holed up for the past few months working on the latest patch and the results... they have turned the whole game upside down.
I come to you with The Sunny Life in First Person Perspective!

[previewyoutube=kHAhTHwSAVY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]First Person Perspective[/b]

The game has gained a new immersion-boosting perspective! All in-game mechanics have been adapted to the new gameview. Enjoy your favourite activities such as cooking, fishing or planting from new point of view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38333011/b81318d42ecf1b272f04981b5a57c43dce088e29.png[/img]

[b]New map[/b]
The map has been changed to a completely new location - setting up our town on a beautiful island surrounded by the sea.

You can start your game from scratch or use your saved game progress. If you choose the latter, please note that all buildable items (from your house and shop) can be found behind your house and set up again.

Nevertheless, I invite you to start the adventure all over again!

Thank you for reading and have fun!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1: Economic Rebalance, Piper, Tree Saplings
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38333011/01ac0c25d96a72537d2555c91eea9df75c9aa950.png[/img]

Hi! 

The first major patch has arrived!
So what's new?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38333011/8891faecd68d1372a6ecf65df3fef679dbf4bb96.jpg[/img]

[b]Economic rebalance and new customer algorithm[/b]
The game definitely promoted grind at work rather than other methods of earning money. To this end, the value of all items acquired has increased significantly, dishes made of fish include the price of ingredients and selling in a own shop is much more profitable than selling in a pawnshop. In addition, customers have received a new much smoother algorithm for navigating the shop.

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Unfortunately prices are saved with the item so only newly acquired items will have the new price.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38333011/b080c47e65637283852d912f3262f5031dd83719.jpg[/img]

[b]Piper[/b]
There is a new resident in the town. She is a local journalist Piper! You're sure to get some spicy secrets about the residents from her.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38333011/2c6dafd5761d6539aaca0d474b35a4b192708580.jpg[/img]

[b]Tree Seedlings[/b]
From now on you can grow fruit trees in your garden!

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Unfortunately, after loading the game you have to wait a day for them to appear in the garden shop.

Changelog of minor changes:
-The grill has been repaired! It allows the cooking of individual good quality ingredients
-Steak appears correctly in recipes
-Fruit trees act correctly in winter
-The skills window indicates the levels already achieved
-and more...

The roadmap will be updated next week.

[b]Thanks for reading and have fun![/b]

notes.title: Progress Update #1
notes.content:
Hello!
First of all, I would like to apologize for the long lack of information about what is happening in the project. At the same time, I would like to assure you that the project is still under development and I work on it almost every day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38333011/3652b049b90d62ce7d88b050acd4bba6eecd0032.png[/img]

List of unfinished things that need to be on the release, and I've been working recently on them:
-Customer behaviour and shop development
-Finishing the system of needs
-Fishing system
-Relationships system

Most core systems have been finished, and I will soon start filling them with content.
The release date I am aiming for is the end of 2021.
